content.text:
No, `user-service.js` isn't using the repositories yet. It still imports `query` and `update` from `../db.js` directly and uses callbacks (`src/services/user-service.js:1`). A comment in the file says the switch to `UserRepository` is planned for "Chapter 5".

`src/repositories/user-repository.js` already has a promise-based version of each function:

| user-service.js (callback) | UserRepository (promise) |
|---|---|
| `listActiveUsers(cb)` | `findActive()` |
| `findUser(id, cb)` | `findById(id)` |
| `softDeleteUser(id, when, cb)` | `softDelete(id, when)` |

Both versions run the same queries, so moving the service over would mostly mean changing the calling style from callbacks to promises. That would also break the callback-based callers and tests (for example `tests/user-service.test.js`) unless they're updated too. The repo has a `migrate-module` skill for this kind of change; I can run it if you want.
